selection.population: all TNG100-1 galaxies, 1e9 < M* < 1e12 Msun (centrals and satellites)
selection.warning: STORED AS A VERTICAL ENVELOPE (band), not as the polygon: at each x of a regular 0.05-dex grid, yLow and yHigh are the lowest and highest y where the plotted contour path crosses that x and y is their mid-point (not a median or a ridge). The path vertices were read exactly, then reduced to this band because the dataset requires x to increase along a connected record. Concavities of the contour are filled by the band (0 of 36 grid x values have a crossing gap), and a path that is a single curve in x has zero width. Vertices of one contour of the conditional 2-D kernel density estimate of the TNG100-1 colour-mass plane, read from the vector paths of Nelson et al. 2018 (MNRAS 475, 624), Fig. 2 (g-r panel, blue lines); no table is published. The caption states 'Conditional 2D kernel density estimates (KDEs) are shown with contours at {0.2,0.5,0.75,0.98}'; it does not say what the numbers are. The four drawn opacities (0.05, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0) nest, and the assignment outermost = 0.2 ... innermost = 0.98 is an inference: it reproduces, to within 0.007 mag at the lower edge in all four levels, the contour edges predicted by taking the level as the fraction of the peak of the conditional PDF (Fig. 1 PDF of the same run, mass bin 9.5-10), and reproduces the alternative reading as enclosed probabilities less well (0.01-0.03 mag off); the reading is not proven. This path is the red sequence. Open path: truncated by the plot edge (log M* = 9 or 12). Contour pieces with fewer than 20 vertices (slivers at the plot edge) are not stored (0 at this level). Dust: Model C resolved dust (N_side=1); whether Fig. 2 uses all 12 projections or one random one is not stated. The SDSS contours (black) and the u-i, u-r, r-i panels are not extracted.
selection.contourKind: level of the conditional 2-D KDE as listed in the caption; read as a fraction of the per-mass peak density (inferred, see warning)
selection.contourRepresentation: vertical envelope: y = mid-point, yLow/yHigh = lowest/highest crossing; 0.05-dex x grid
